customDomain.instructionsEmail.introAt: We are putting {truckName}'s live schedule on {address}, and it needs one record adding to our domain at {provider}.
customDomain.instructionsEmail.introHold: We are putting {truckName}'s live schedule on {address}, and it needs one record adding to our domain with whoever holds our domain.
customDomain.instructionsEmail.subject: One record to add for {truckName}'s schedule page
customDomain.providers.123reg.manage: Beside "Domains", select "Manage All", then choose your web address.
customDomain.providers.123reg.name: Put the first value below in "Name".
customDomain.providers.123reg.signIn: Sign in to your "123 Reg Control Panel".
customDomain.providers.123reg.value: Put the second value below in "Value", and add a full stop to the end of it.
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.add: Select "Add record", then pick "CNAME" as the "Type".
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.name: Put the first value below in "Name".
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.open: Open your web address, then "DNS" and "Records".
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.proxy: Set "Proxy status" to "DNS only" — the cloud beside it must be grey, not orange.
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.value: Put the second value below in "Target".
customDomain.providers.godaddy.add: Select "Add New Record", then pick "CNAME" from the "Type" menu.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.caveat: If you added more than one at once, the button says "Save All Records".
customDomain.providers.godaddy.name: Put the first value below in "Name".
customDomain.providers.godaddy.open: Open your "Domain Portfolio" and choose your web address.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.save: Leave "TTL" as it is and select "Save".
customDomain.providers.godaddy.value: Put the second value below in "Value".
customDomain.providers.wix.add: In the "CNAME (Aliases)" section, click "+ Add Record", then click "Got it".
customDomain.providers.wix.name: Put the first value below in "Host Name".
customDomain.providers.wix.open: Open "Domains", then click the "Domain Actions" icon beside your web address.
customDomain.providers.wix.save: Click "Save", then click "Save Changes" in the pop-up.
customDomain.providers.wix.value: Put the second value below in "Value".

manageWhatsApp.billing.aboveGeneral: Your limit is above Meta's {free, number} free replies. Replies beyond that need a payment method on your WhatsApp account; without one, Meta stops all replies once the free ones are used.

manageWhatsApp.billing.chargesBody: Each reply HatchGrab sends for you is billed by Meta to your WhatsApp Business account. From {from}, Meta includes {free, number} free replies a month per number; after that, each reply is charged at Meta's rate. Replies you send yourself from the WhatsApp Business app aren't charged. Meta sets these prices and may change them. <link>See Meta's pricing</link>
manageWhatsApp.billing.summary: Meta, not HatchGrab, bills your WhatsApp account for replies. From {from} the first {free, number} a month are free. Correct at {checked}; check <link>Meta's pricing</link> for changes.
